source_summary: Strict source documents must carry explicit source metadata and atomic claims. Runtime lowering is gated by supported claim kinds and claim_can_lower_to_runtime rather than by source enthusiasm alone.
current_truth: Source-backed claims can drive Mulligan, CardID behavior, Combo, and GlobalValues posture only when the claim kind, cards, confidence, and optional runtime hints are valid for that surface.
repo_alignment: source_document_builder.py validates source_documents.json, source_document_model.py defines lowering support, and source_claim_gap_report.py now exposes the first missing source-builder chain.
implementation_implication: Do not relax runtime lowering just because evidence collection is more aggressive. Convert weak evidence into visible gaps or report-only support instead.
gaps_or_risks: Claim confidence can be overstated if Codex compresses multiple guide statements into one row.
Combo emission remains intentionally narrow because exact sequence data is required.
recommended_action: Keep strict validation in source_document_builder and use source_claim_gap_report priority to decide which missing claim to research next.
